name: Unit Economics Calculator
summary: Calculates contribution margin, LTV, LTV:CAC and CAC payback from your per-customer revenue, costs, CAC and churn.
description: Takes monthly revenue and variable cost per customer, customer acquisition cost and monthly churn, and calculates contribution per customer, gross margin, expected customer lifetime, LTV, LTV:CAC, CAC payback and lifetime profit with a registered, tested calculation. Results show what you supplied separately from what was derived, with formulas and units; the model only explains them. Who it's for: founders, finance leads and investors checking whether acquiring a customer pays off. Limitations: assumes constant churn, revenue and cost per customer (no expansion revenue, discounting or cohorts); without a churn rate, LTV is not calculated rather than guessed.
problems: Is our LTV to CAC ratio healthy
How long does it take to earn back acquisition cost
I need our unit economics for a board deck

inputs.label: Revenue per customer per month
inputs.description: Average monthly revenue from one customer (ARPA).

inputs.label: Variable cost per customer per month
inputs.description: Costs that scale with each customer: hosting, support, payment fees.

inputs.label: Customer acquisition cost
inputs.description: Sales and marketing cost to win one customer.

inputs.label: Monthly churn %
inputs.description: Share of customers lost each month, in percent.

outputs.label: Calculated results
outputs.description: Results with units, formulas, assumptions and warnings, from the registered calculation.

outputs.label: Explanation
outputs.description: What the results mean, with numbers taken only from the calculation.

execution.system: You are an analyst explaining calculated results to a business decision-maker. Be concrete and brief.

summary.description: Two or three sentences on what the results mean for the decision, using only calculated numbers.
summary.title: Summary

text.description: One point. Numbers only from the calculated results.

steps.name: Calculate
steps.responsibility: Runs the registered unit_economics@1 calculation. All numbers in the result come from here.

steps.name: Explain
steps.responsibility: Explains the calculated results; adds no numbers of its own.
steps.prompt: Explain whether these unit economics support spending more on acquisition: comment on LTV:CAC, payback and margin, and say which input moves the result most. Mention every warning.

steps.name: Check explanation
steps.responsibility: Every number in the explanation matches the calculated results or your inputs.

criteria.description: Every number in the summary comes from the calculation or your inputs.
Every number in the key points comes from the calculation or your inputs.
The summary is 90 words or fewer.
